Who we are

A small, dedicated team with a shared belief — that the habits children develop early determine the kind of world they grow into.

Our mission

Happy Green World Foundation develops environmental education programmes for children aged 6–16 around the world. Our curriculum focuses on three core themes — waste, water, and energy — and is adapted for each community we work in.

We create activity guides, student books, games, and coloring sheets with culturally relevant illustrations, then partner with local NGOs, schools, and organisations to deliver them to children who need them most.

"We do not inherit the earth from our ancestors — we borrow it from our children."

Who we are, what we do, and why it matters

Who

The Happy Green World Foundation develops educational programs regarding waste, water and energy with the aim to encourage sustainable behaviour in children aged 4 to 16 years old.

What

Our quality educational programs consist of practical and playful activity guides, student books and games. The educational materials are custom made regarding illustrations, translation and content — adapting to the partner's country, culture, language and customs.

Why

Our goal is to offer environmental education in the curriculum of countries all over the world. Children who learn sustainable behaviour at a young age will become adults who actively contribute to a cleaner and healthier living environment — a Happy Green World!

How

Partner with us and teach environmental education in your local community. We guide you through every step of a successful project. Partners are encouraged to find a local sponsor to fund development and printing — and their logos can be displayed on the educational materials.

How it started

2009

Marlou Jongejan-Bessem, then an environmental consultant, begins working in Cairo — and witnesses firsthand the devastating impact of poor waste management on communities and children.

2013

Happy Green World Foundation (Stichting Happy Green World) is formally established in the Netherlands. Petra Houweling joins as co-founder and illustrator. Anja van Velzen joins as Treasurer. The first educational materials are created for Egypt.

2014–2019

The partnership model expands to Indonesia, Senegal, Ghana, Ethiopia, and beyond. Materials are localised for each new country with culturally specific illustrations and examples.

2020

Karin van Jeveren joins the team in Australia, strengthening communications and design. The foundation now operates in 8+ countries across Africa, Asia, Europe, and Oceania.

Today

Happy Green World works with local partners in 12+ countries, continuing to develop new programmes and deepen existing partnerships — always guided by the belief that lasting environmental change begins in the classroom.

Meet the team

A small group of passionate people, working from the Netherlands and Australia to create educational materials used by children around the world.

Marlou Jongejan-Bessem

Founder

Marlou is an environmental consultant based in Perth, Australia. Her passion for environmental education began in Cairo in 2009, where she witnessed the devastating effects of unmanaged waste firsthand. She founded Happy Green World in 2013 with the conviction that lasting environmental change starts with children. Today she leads the foundation's global partnerships and continues to develop new programmes alongside local communities.

Petra Houweling

Illustrator & Co-founder

Petra is a Netherlands-based graphic designer who has co-created Happy Green World's visual identity from the very beginning. She designs all of the foundation's educational materials — creating bright, warm illustrations that are carefully adapted to reflect the cultural context of each country we work in. Her artwork makes complex environmental ideas accessible and joyful for children aged 6–16.

Karin van Jeveren

Volunteer — Communication & Design

Karin holds a degree in Communication and Design and relocated to Australia, where she joined Happy Green World in 2020. She is a passionate advocate for early environmental education, believing that the habits children form today shape the world they will inherit. Karin contributes her skills across communications and design to help share the foundation's story with the world.

Want to work with us?

If you represent a school, NGO, foundation, or corporate programme and want to bring Happy Green World to your community, we'd love to hear from you.
